name: TC-BUS-02: lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Ashok Leyland Buses
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Buses/BusListing.cy.js#Buses - BusListing [ashokLeylandBuses] [en] — Ashok Leyland Buses TC-BUS-02: lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Ashok Leyland Buses
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUS-02
**Title:** Lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Ashok Leyland Buses
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Ashok Leyland Buses page, open the lead form via "Check Bus Price", and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Ashok Leyland Buses page
2. Click "Check Bus Price" to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
